估计是游戏内容不多，它把难度设的很高，就是想让你玩久点。游戏是纯运气游戏，build好就乱杀不好就等着重开，而且很有可能前面拿的很顺后面拿的都是不相关，导致牌组直接变一坨，玩过土豆兄弟的都知道，那游戏这方面做的比这游戏好多了。 正式版比起demo，游戏体验根本没有好多少，经常是强度不够然后打到二十几波就要重开，玩了一个小时多了还没把初始角色打到30关通关。我觉得这个体量，定价54确实是太贵了，35就差不多了
故意恶心玩家的游戏，受虐体质买，想爽想休闲的别买。 特别上头，一直想顺着网线过去给开发者一拳头。 小怪数值卡你，BOSS机制卡你。 这个游戏就是不停的在教育你，玩游戏就得功利，组尼玛的套路？在强大的数值面前，套路不值一提，给我老老实实的克制自己组套路的欲望，每一步都要计算性价比。 高星出门第一关选错直接G。我玩尼玛！！！ 打输了，那个BOSS还要嘲讽你一句，给你血压拉满。 吃我一拳！

降价后更新： 我本来说价格降了还想说点好话。 但是，为什么降价前支持福利包括一个“以后的皮肤免费使用”啊？？？ 合着这种赌运气的单机你们想买皮肤啊？？？？？ Update after price reduction: I would have said something nicer after lowering the price. But why are you offering "free cosmetics afterwards" to those supporter ???? Do you mean that you are going to SELL COSMETICS IN A LUCK BASED SINGLE PLAYER GAME like wtf bro?????????? —————————————————————— 价格这么贵，我以为是优化了多少内容呢；数值依旧用脚填的，终点线max 30%攻速，但是辣椒就25%，白卡秒表都有10%；局外成长线不明不白，获得钱的方式不明不白，并且饼干还被削弱了，成长线莫名拉长；小祥和鸡煲一星都过不了，直接死；boss和demo版一样都一次能卡死特定的build，比如打25关你没有反甲/护盾基本就是死；稀释卡池的问题顶级严重，而且鸡煲更是顶级设计，开局不给愤怒平静你卡池里塞一堆“若平静时”，纯纯卡手，不会做条件洗入吗？ 然后你的价格是多少来着？50？50我玩尼玛这个？你们拖了几个月屁都没搞？ 我记得公告还说更新太多东西和demo已经不一样？也许，但是我们体验有啥差别啊？目前感觉就是一个巨大的demo，甚至不如之前的demo简单，上瘾，刺激。目前这个游戏一点策略性都没有，毕竟3张牌张张没用的可能性太高了。 你们随便拉一个网友给你们设计都不至于搞成这样，我是说真的，因为这个网友只要骂你们“这个太强了”，你们改一下数值表都很快。 你们宣传片说的好，确实李佳琪，不值得。 先退款，等你们改改再说。 --------- Given the price, I expect a more polished, dedicated work, however the upgrade from demo seems to be extremely underwhelming. Randomly assigned values, like the Finish LIne give at max 25% AS while Red Chili Gives 25% with them being the same tier, even the common card gives you 10 percent. The guide for cross-round growth is super confusing. You get boosts from nowhere and the action is unpredicatable. As I spend 60 to chat with Kideo and receive nothing. It also becomes so length after the nerf to the cookie. Unable to pass the levels with the 2nd and 3rd characters. Boss is a pure luck checker, if you don't choose certain growth, you die. The 3rd character also has a lot of prerequisite for most of the builds, which you cannot guarantee to have at all. Also, the price is too high! Are you even serious for how much it upgraded since the DEMO? The DEMO even says that it's unable to update due to new contents, and where even are them? It's only a character mod we have. Eventually it feels worse than the DEMO, because the old one was simple and addictive. This one is complex but uncontrollable, Even any player can design better, just reporting anything that is too good or too bad, and fix the number, this game won't be so horrible. Not recommended. Until anything has changed. This game does have potential but I am not their tutor to wait them grow.

Don't be dissuade by the non-recommendation when you look at this game. It's not a terrible game by any means and the conversation about the RNG factor is arguable on how true it is. It's an autobattle roguelike deckbuilder so expect alot of things to be out of your control simply on principle of it being an autobattler roguelike deckbuilder. If you do consider playing this game, I would recommend you to take your initial few runs with a grain of salt. That's because the starting character you begin with... Honestly, they are absolute, hot garbage. By far, the worst character in the game. Every other character atleast have some sort of gimmick or better starting tool that it's kind of ridiculous the creator thought the starting character should be in the state that they are. Simple tierlist that I devised from playing each character: F tier: Player Character (Meme Lord) - Easily the worst character in the game. Starts with 6 rocks... which are the worst attacks in the game. Does not have a gimmick ability aside from rocks, and has anti-synergy with every other element in the game. D Tier: Senpai, Salad Bunny - They are... Fine? They have a huge gimmick in their gameplay so it makes their gameplay hard to play around. Considering they are the last ones you will unlock, it makes sense that they have very unique gimmicks that doesn't revolve around the 3 main synergies (Strength, Energy/Ultimate, Attack Stacking). Their gimmicks really doesn't warrant them being better than the other standardized character and are really just interesting for their gimmicks. C Tier: Keg, Pre-Bandleader: Keg is just an ultimate merchant but has pretty solid damage and tankiness. They are a slow character so they're definitely not amazing compared to the other characters but serves its purpose. Pre-Bandleader on the other hand is rather good, but has a high risk, high reward gimmick. She's rather good once you get a run going, but she's a character that requires you to solely focus on getting the foundations built before you can branch out on what you want to build. Usually that just involves building Health Regen/Health so that you can buy anything in the shop and not die instantly as soon as you enter the next match. B Tier: Perfect, Jaws Jora - Perfect is a pretty good summation of a good gimmick character. Doesn't have a downside, scales exponentially, and doesn't really have a weakness other than require setup. Jaws Jora has a really strong starting kit. Armor+Large Starting Deck+Debuffs, she's quite strong. Not to mention that she gets access to Anti-thorns which is her counter, she's a pretty strong character. A Tier: Filthy Priest, Mystic Wheeler - Filthy Priest gets access to ninja (one of the best attack in the game) and every other attack. Although they start with lower hp than other character, just having access to every attack in the game makes his deck OP. While Mystic Wheeler Has incredible base stats and a gimmick that gives you massive scaling. He pretty much cleans up every boss imaginable which makes him one of the best. There's a large learning curve in this game and after you find the niche for each character, it does get a little stale. Hopefully the modding community props this game up bc I see potential in this game. In the state that it is right now, it's a solid 6/10 experience. Definitely not bad, but mildly entertaining.

I understand this is a niche game... what i don't understand is people complaining about RNG in a roguelike deckbuilder. Do people not understand what those two genres are built on? Even the darlings of the hybrid genre (STS and MTrain) are RNG dependent. Granted less so than MM, but here the runs are so short if you get a bad one it's not like you're married to it. Normally don't review many games, but seeing all the negative reception to a game i'm really enjoying made me feel the need to add a little in the other direction. FYI: check out the reviews in your language only. Because while the game was once as low as 29% recommended and is now sitting at around 40%... when you limit the reviews to 'English Only' it's actually 90% recommended. Seems to be a Chinese review bomb going on over their dissatisfaction with the pricing in China.

看到键盘侠降价，我真的很感动，听劝的制作组无论游戏做的如何，总归是让人安心的。 如果之后能保持更新频率，多做出人物和新卡，就更让人惊喜了。 这个游戏从demo开始我就一直陪伴，也曾一度打上每周挑战的榜首，看着它如今发售，新角色像雨后春笋般长出，每每探索出一个角色的体系和玩法，都会让我快乐许久。 衷心感谢键盘侠制作组给我带来的愉快的游戏体验，也希望键盘侠团队越做越好，早日超过游戏科学（doge）

I don't really know if the developers of this game really are that invested in the balance of this game. At time of writing, I only have 8 hours roughly in game time, but you don't really need more than that to realize how inconsistent this game truly is. A lot of people bring up the RNG of the game and rightly so. The problem isn't that it's a "deck building" game so much as there's a LOT of Perks and Items that are just dead weight. It's almost impossible to have any coherent "build" outside of getting lucky. That in and of itself is also not inherently a negative. However, with the way the game is balanced, most "average" builds just will not win you a run. In fact, in many cases a more "optimized" build where you do get decent synergy will also not be enough to win you a run. This game does not test your ability to formulate a plan. It does not test your ability to adapt and make the best of a bad situation. This game does not test your strategic depth. This game simply tests how many runs you are willing to attempt before you give up all together.

第五次更新于2024.9.29 00:28 近期多次与制作组工作人员进行沟通，关于本游戏玩法机制、制作组未来展望等事宜聊了很多，可以感受得到制作组的诚意，也解开了许多误会。在我看来，制作组确实没有圈＆润的打算，以往做的错事也多是不熟悉国内互联网环境造成。一开始写评论的时候有些情绪化了，考虑到本评论目前处于置顶区，有一定的影响力，故在此进行说明。往期评论未删改，记录了前因后果，也给大家看个乐子做个参考。以上，以后可能不会再更新此评论。 第四次更新于2024.9.20 08:22 今天凌晨三点和制作组进行了电话沟通，主要是针对本评测问题进行答疑。沟通中制作组核心成员表示认识到自己的错误并诚挚致歉。核心内容有两点： 1.制作组全员为美国留学生，由于缺乏前期市场调研，对国内独游定价这一块不太了解，直接对标美国独游，导致前期定价天崩开局。同时，由于在国外生活时间较长，对于国内互联网网络节奏缺乏敏感度，也就是所谓“网感”较差，导致发售后制作组明明是想补救却造成了更大的舆情风波； 2.制作组有其他非pc端游戏业务且现金流健康，不至于需要圈＆润。他们有自己的想法及对未来的展望，具体信息无法透露更多，但肯定是想本本分分赚钱做口碑的公司，所以希望玩家对他们能有更积极的期待，相信他们能把这款游戏打磨地更好。 首次评测写于2024.9.19 00:33 关于这款游戏的玩法机制等优缺点其他评论已经写的很清楚了，我就不再赘述。今天在评论区化身赛博史官，给大家讲讲这款游戏的前世今朝。评论区欢迎补充。 本人是6月底时被朋友推荐着玩了demo，demo流派不多数值一坨，能否通关全看胡不胡，玩起来很是上头，就一直期待正式版。 正式版原定7.12上线，7.11时作者说“提前一个月送审，但懒狗v社不回消息，截止目前没过审，我们也不知道到了预定发售日期会怎么办balabalabala”然后7.12就不出意外地跳票了。demo的boss是川普，跳票没两天川普被枪击更是让跳票成了艺术。（有人说是游戏没过审作者去枪击的川普，我暂且蒙在鼓里）这个时候玩家群中的大家也都很能理解，毕竟作者第一次做独立游戏没经验，找发行商发行的话又会被多抽一道成。所以大家无非也就是调侃调侃，说什么跳票到拳打黑猴脚踩space marine2，群内氛围也还其乐融融。 但是跳票时间久了且一直不给具体发行日期，玩家们多少有点急，希望作者更新demo，让老玩家有点新体验，在等待游戏发行时至少不会太无聊。8月8日作者发布群公告，原话”Demo的本意是让新玩家品尝一下游戏的味道，并且距离上次更新已经2个多月了，所以Demo目前的代码架构已经和游戏本体非常不兼容了——比如我们已经重写了波次的底层逻辑。更新Demo意味着我们需要花很多时间重构它，然后还需要花更多时间从本体中切下一小块内容放进去。与其花这些时间，我们更愿意花更多的时间在为本体添加更多内容上！希望大家对此理解！“游戏正式上线后，数值比demo更一坨，跟demo比起来内容也没增加多少，demo一开始有的游戏内加速功能被取消，作者承诺正式版会有的无尽模式截止笔者写下这篇评测时也没出，遂被玩家冲烂 8.30，作者宣布过审，但仍旧无法发行，因为发行“需要做准备工作。”9.6，正式确定游戏9.14发售。发售前作者在群内透露售价54，游戏群炸锅，毕竟一个小品级游戏，从demo看来内容也并不丰满，定这个价纯粹是耗子舔猫逼，没事找刺激。但由于跳票已久，群友们都很期待，想着作者有底气定这个价一定有道理，于是大家都期待作者给我们整个狠活 Way too linear and RNG dependant, your only choice while playing is which items to pick up between waves, but most characters only have one viable build-around mechanic despite a choice of several. This is because enemy stats can be so specialised you NEED the right perks to counter them or they will hard-counter you. Very little room for creativity even on the lowest difficulty runs. So much wasted potential with the other builds that are included but just don't really work because of strict stat checks and slow scaling perks. The start of the game is abysmal because you're given the worst character in the game to bash your head against the wall with, I was able to clear the final boss with every other character before them. Thankfully you do not need to complete a run to unlock the next character in the list. But all of them seem to unlock the same way, just make enough progress with the previous one. Going a few runs deep on different characters I can barely tell the difference in ascendancy levels, they seem to be miniscule increases, much like the meta progression buffs. (+10 health in a game that starts in the thousands... thanks) Runs end exactly as abruptly as they do on level 0 when you aren't given the right pieces in time. You do get a chance to re-select your items from the previous wave/shop and try again, sometimes it works, but it is mostly down to luck to what selections you are offered. The skill comes in knowing when to abandon a run because the game is just unwinnable. This would be less of a problem if it were on challenging difficulty runs, but it's like this right from the start. The gameplay loop once you know the builds & bosses is basically reroll the first item until you find a key piece, and then hope the right things show up in the right order. It gets slightly more forgiving as you progress as you earn more rerolls, but it's always brutal. The meta progression system gets old fast, you earn money by reacting to twitter-like posts with emojis. Sometimes you get money for completing a run, and more money for higher ascended runs. Which you spend to gain favor with characters in a system that looks like it was ripped from Hades, with milestones unlocking small buffs or things like extra re-rolls. Reducing the game down to item choices and making all the difficulty center around that one mechanic makes the game feel really flat compared to other rogue-lites where you're traversing some kind of path and can influence to some extent the types of events you encounter, or have any control over combat. It would be a more enjoyable time waster if the difficulty were balanced more fairly. There really is no casual mode to experiment in, it's a hard knowledge check from run 1 difficulty 0. In the current state of the game, I don't see the point of an infinite mode because a winning run is already unkillable by everything. Any kind of weakness in a build will be destroyed, even in non-boss encounters. Like requiring a heavy armor stacking + ice cubes on block run to deal with attack+crit spam enemies, and brains to counter ultimate spam.

Update Correction: The achievement for getting defeated on wave 1 doesn't seem to work at all for hardcore ascending, which was supposed to be easier to get defeated wave 1 from what it sounds like, but it works for regular ascending. That one is honestly really stupid. Another ding for bugs breaking the game. TL;DR - Autobattler that's fun in spurts, but can be frustrating toward the end of a run and achievement hunting is a nightmare until changes are made. Not TL;DR: The game is an auto battler involving memes (wow, who knew). Characters have emojis they launch at their enemies per second. Each full arsenal is launched at a set pace so having more emojis in the arsenal doesn't slow down attacking. Each emoji does something different and each character has emojis they can get or are locked out of getting with a few workarounds and universal ones, including most relics and perks involving them. Perks enhance a character's stats or emojis by either adding more emojis to the arsenal, giving general stat buffs, or giving an effect that works on other stats/emojis. Relics do the same, but (usually) to a greater extent. Relics can also combine with certain other relics to give you both effects enhanced, or an even better effect for ones that require more relics. Ones that had downsides are also removed or lessened, usually. In the standard game, you have 30 battles to face, after each wave giving you a choice of perk, along with a random event every 3rd wave between each boss that provides some relic or gain/loss. Every 5th wave has a shop with 3 relics and 3 perks preceding a boss battle. Each boss has set perk arsenal. Ads between each boss wave are randomized, with ads gaining more perks in later waves. What I like about the game: The variety of builds that are viable early on is abundant. Endless mode makes things fun if you want to try nearly any combination of things available. Modding documentation is easy to read and go through. What keeps this game held back are a few things: Random events sometimes have an order that they'd like to be in to unlock choices in the latter event (gain a key that provides small attack speed in one event that is used to unlock the other event). Sometimes only 1 or 2 events have a specific relic you need to combine and you just don't get it in certain runs or others you get it, but not the other relics needed. If we were able to pay for rerolls with either in-game currency systems, that would help with how bad the rng is for random events. Same for relic choices after each boss. One free reroll each for boss relics, events, and shop items is nice, but definitely feels like all the rerolls should just work for wherever you want them to, including the generic perk rerolls that I sometimes just don't use. If not, maybe allowing a pre-ban list for relics, perks, and events would also be nice. Difficulty spikes too much for ads between waves 26-29. Lower it slightly or make the assortment they can get more random because it feels like they're meant to counter my build if I'm not beating them in 1 second by the time I reach that point. Honestly, if you wanna play more than a few hours of the game to get all the achievements, this game is not worth it with the current issues. It's fun every now and then, but it gets frustrating at points.

I want to start this review by stating that this game overall is fun and worth buying. Its true that its pretty random and maybe don't encourage truly strategic gameplay but I guess its not really the point here. Its silly game about fighting people in internet with emojis. Its a ez to turn on and play, and what I mean by that is - If you dont feel like playing anything that requires a lot of brain power, you can just sit back, draft builds and watch as emotes and dmg numbers go brrrrr. There are a lots of playable characters (at the moment i am writing this 11) and they bring some twist to the way the game is played out so overall I would recommend this game but.... The reason I am giving no is mostly due to one design decision that just kills my will to play it more - ascension per champion. In game when you have 11 characters and so many other possible games to play, there is no way you realistically unlock apparently 30 ascension levels (I am not sure if 30 is the limit or if there is more) on every character. With so many characters I think its a given that you would like to swap them between the runs, and when you spent more time on the game, you just stomp easier levels which is not really fun, and just feels like a waste of time. There is already option to swap between unlocked ascensions back and forth, so why would you lock other characters from possibility to choose the highest ascension the player got to in game with any given character. I just feel like I need to bring at least some attention to this problem as its copied in sooo many games and its just feels so bad (like people creating games just don't respect their players time). So this is why at the end I give a thumbs down. If there is any chance that devs see this and change this flaw I will gladly change my review to thumbs up.
